content.title: Kura Sushi’s (NASDAQ:KRUS) Q4 CY2025 Earnings Results: Revenue In Line With Expectations
content.summary: Sushi restaurant chain Kura Sushi (NASDAQ:KRUS) met Wall Streets revenue expectations in Q4 CY2025, with sales up 14% year on year to $73.46 million. The company’s full-year revenue guidance of $332 million at the midpoint came in 0.7% above analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP loss of $0.23 per share was 45.6% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
